mapper.sql: LOG_ID, OCCURRED_AT, EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, EVENT_TYPE, HTTP_METHOD, REQ_PATH, STATUS_CODE, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, DURATION_MS, DETAIL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCESS_LOG (OCCURRED_AT, EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, EVENT_TYPE, HTTP_METHOD, REQ_PATH, STATUS_CODE, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, DURATION_MS, DETAIL) VALUES (#{occurredAt}, #{empNo}, #{empVerified}, #{eventType}, #{httpMethod}, #{reqPath}, #{statusCode}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{durationMs}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ACCESS_LOG ORDER BY LOG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM ACCESS_LOG ORDER BY LOG_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
